purpose: Fail-closed Milestone A evaluation contract for concealed target-free rediscovery; passing is necessary but not sufficient for a capability claim.

target_generation.process_boundary: target seed and target AST remain outside candidate/search process
target_generation.commitment: SHA-256 commitment required before any arm executes
target_generation.reveal: only after every frozen arm completes or times out

splits.development: may be used to implement the protocol but not to set final thresholds after evaluation
splits.confirmation: fresh evaluator-generated targets unavailable to development and repository code before freeze

matched_budget.stop_rule: first of candidate-evaluation cap or wall deadline

automatic_blockers: target material visible to candidate process
limitations: protocol infrastructure is not an executed result
not evidence of representation invention or general intelligence
